label: def:skewed-poisson-structure
title: Poisson structure on a splay
html:
Let (A_i)_{i \in I} be commutative algebras over a field k. Their splay is the diagram of inclusions A_i \hookrightarrow T into the coproduct T = \coprod_i A_i in the category of algebras (the free product); T is the splay algebra and the A_i are its coordinate algebras.

A Poisson structure on an algebra A is a skew-symmetric bi-derivation \pi satisfying the Jacobi identity. A Poisson structure on the splay (the paper's name; called here a skewed-Poisson structure) is a Poisson structure \pi on T with internal symmetry:

  \pi(A_i, A_i) = 0 \qquad \text{for every } i \in I.

If T = \bigcup_n T^{(n)} is filtered, \pi is strongly filtered when \pi(T^{(m)}, T^{(n)}) \subseteq T^{(m+n-1)}.

The canonical example is the commutator \pi_c(a, b) = ab - ba ([leitner2006], Example 1.2). In the application the A_i are the distribution algebras \mathrm{Dist}(H_i) of commutative formal groups.

Reference: [leitner2006], Definition 1.1.
